base.what: control: the real Clawd soundtrack untouched
base.first_action: nothing reaches body level until 0:01.01 (before that the sound sits around -42 LUFS, 27 LU under the body; refs 0.04 s .. 0.48 s): raise the opening or start the music at 0:00

quiet.first_action: raise the master by +13.0 dB to about -14 LUFS integrated (web) with a true-peak limiter (ceiling -1 dBTP); if the limiter works harder than ~3 dB, compress the music bus first (refs -22.2 LUFS .. -7.3 LUFS)

hot.what: 12 dB hotter, clipped by the 16-bit file
hot.first_action: turn the master down by 7.8 dB to about -12 LUFS: above -9 LUFS normalising platforms turn it down anyway and the limiter flattens every hit (refs -22.2 LUFS .. -7.3 LUFS)

mono.first_action: nothing reaches body level until 0:01.01 (before that the sound sits around -43 LUFS, 26 LU under the body; refs 0.04 s .. 0.48 s): raise the opening or start the music at 0:00

muffled.first_action: nothing reaches body level until 0:00.94 (before that the sound sits around -44 LUFS, 29 LU under the body; refs 0.04 s .. 0.48 s): raise the opening or start the music at 0:00

late.what: 2.5 s of silence before the start
late.first_action: nothing reaches body level until 0:03.51 (before that the sound sits around -46 LUFS, 32 LU under the body; refs 0.04 s .. 0.48 s): raise the opening or start the music at 0:00

deadair.what: 4 s of silence after the end
deadair.first_action: 4.1 s of dead air after the sound ends at 0:59.93: trim the picture or let the final sting ring out over the end card (refs 0.02 s .. 1.90 s)

fadeout.first_action: the final moment sits 11.9 LU below the body: end on a logo sting / hit instead of fading away (refs -2.2 LU .. 5.6 LU)

hole.first_action: nothing reaches body level until 0:01.01 (before that the sound sits around -42 LUFS, 27 LU under the body; refs 0.04 s .. 0.48 s): raise the opening or start the music at 0:00

squashed.first_action: true peak +0.3 dBTP: end the master chain with a true-peak limiter, ceiling -1.0 dBTP, then re-encode

sfx_only.first_action: raise the master by +13.6 dB to about -14 LUFS integrated (web) with a true-peak limiter (ceiling -1 dBTP); if the limiter works harder than ~3 dB, compress the music bus first (refs -22.2 LUFS .. -7.3 LUFS)
